    02The download race

    Feel the difference
    before you choose.

    Same download, four speed bands, side by side. Pick the band that fits how your home actually uses the internet.

    1. Essential

      Up to 80Mbps

      1 hr 23 min

      ≈ 3 × 4K streams at once

    2. Superfast

      Up to 330Mbps

      20 min 12 sec

      ≈ 13 × 4K streams at once

    3. Ultrafast

      Up to 550Mbps

      12 min 7 sec

      ≈ 22 × 4K streams at once

    4. Gigabit

      Up to 1000Mbps

      6 min 40 sec

      ≈ 40 × 4K streams at once

    Illustration only: simple maths at the top of each band's "up to" speed (1GB = 8,000 megabits; one 4K stream taken as about 25Mbps). Real downloads depend on your line, your Wi-Fi and the service you're downloading from. Your address-specific speed information is confirmed before you order.

    04Home phone

    Add Digital Voice (optional add-on)

    Home Phone over broadband — keep your number where porting is available and plug into a compatible router. Add-on to your broadband, from £4.95/month.

    • Works with your broadband connection
    • Keep your existing phone number where porting is available
    • Use most standard home phones with compatible equipment
    • Optional call plans available
    Important: Digital Voice needs power and broadband to work. Emergency calls (999/112) may not work during a power cut or broadband outage. If you or someone in your household relies on a phone line in an emergency, please tell us so we can discuss back-up options.

    Digital Voice Add-on

    £4.95/mo

    Digital calling through your broadband connection. Equipment compatibility and number porting are confirmed as part of setup.
